thread:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing launch post cadence + benchmark narrative for the PLG funnel experiment. Need: hero copy, 3 micro-variants, webinar guest ops, inbound routing rules for leads (credits vs no-credits), and activation nudges in onboarding. Can we land by EOD tomorrow?

aj (content): On copy: I’ll draft 3 headline variants and short bodies for web/email/slack. Tentative hero angles: 
- Starter credits → 'Get started with 500 free tokens'
- Templates-first → 'Ship with prompts that work'
- Benchmarked savings → 'Lower per-token cost than X'
I’ll post snippets in the thread by 5pm.

kevin (product-marketing): Can we fold the benchmark narrative into the launch post as a small stats block? Proposed: 'Median gen latency: 180ms; Avg cost/token: $0.0009 on our config' — need eng signoff. Webinar update: guest confirmed — Anya from Acme (ops AI). We should tease content: 'Build a search assistant with templates + free credits'.

leah (ops): Routing thoughts: prefer high-intent leads who redeem credits → route to self-serve AE; others → marketing nurture. Proposed rule (pseudo):
```
if (lead.source == 'launch_post' || lead.campaign == 'launch-webinar') {
  if (lead.credits_redeemed >= 1) route = 'sales-self-serve';
  else if (lead.email_activity >= 2) route = 'marketing-nurture';
  else route = 'drip-7day';
}
```
We also need HubSpot mapping: set lead_source = 'launch_post', tag = 'launch_apr26'.

maria: That rule looks good. For the benchmark numbers, kevin — can you slot in 2 variants: conservative and aspirational? We should A/B test the stat block copy.

aj: Will do headline + 3 microcopy variants. Also prepping 6 prompt templates to include in the post and webinar follow-up (templates: customer-support, semantic-search, summarization, code-assist, rewriting, persona-driven reply).

kevin: Metrics to track from day 0: launch_post CTR, credits-redemption rate, activation (first-successful-gen in 24h), webinar signups → attendance → Qs asked count, demo-requests. I'll make a dashboard request.

calendar-bot: event created — 'Launch webinar rehearsal' • 2026-04-05 10:00 UTC • attendees: @maria @aj @kevin @leah.

leah: Also: inbound form tweak — add a single-click 'I want credits' checkbox so we capture intent without gating the form. If checked, set utm_credit_intent = true. Small front-end ask for eng.

maria: Activation nudges inside onboarding: show 'Try a template' carousel after first gen, plus a 1-click "Use this template" CTA that preloads the prompt. That drove lift in past experiments.

aj: Microcopy for the CTA variants: 'Try this', 'Use template', 'One-click demo'. I'll include CTAs tied to personas (platform engineer vs PM).

kevin: Can someone add a short regression checklist for the benchmark numbers? We need to ensure the config used is clearly documented (model name, seq len, quantization) when we publish.

leah: I'll draft the routing/HS mapping and the form checkbox PR. ETA: tomorrow noon.

maria: Sweet. Action items: @aj = copy + CTAs; @kevin = benchmark narrative + dashboard; @leah = routing + HS mapping + form PR. Check-in tomorrow 11:00am PT. :thumbsup:

aj: Sounds good — I’ll post the first batch of snippets in this thread later today. :raised_hands:
